title: Japanese-Style Cabbage Bowl
description: A simple and healthy Japanese-inspired dish made with sautéed cabbage and topped with a velvety sauce.
instructions: Cut the cabbage into thin strips and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sesame oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the cabbage to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until it starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Pour the velvety sauce over the cabbage and stir to coat.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cabbage is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Transfer the cabbage to a bowl and top with sesame seeds.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and a drizzle of soy sauce, if desired.
